verdict_reason: The expected groups are correctly cut to five, but the title still says six and one assertion cannot fail.

todos.issue: The title 'Should list the six group captions, and under them the task titles, ...' claims six groups, but with the contact-address group removed the assertion (lines 117-144) now expects five; the diff updated the expected array and left the title saying six.
todos.fix: Must: the test title states the number of group captions the assertion expects (five), or names no count. One way: retitle to 'Should list the five group captions, and under them the task titles, in the order Save and continue visits them'.

todos.issue: In 'Should link every task row to its page with exactly the Overview mark added', expect(pagePathOfRow).not.toContain('?') cannot fail: pagePathOfRow is item.href.split('?')[0], so it never holds a '?' whatever the production href is. Only line 99 proves anything.
todos.fix: Must: every assertion in the test can turn red when the production href changes. One way: delete line 98 and rely on line 99's exact toBe, or assert the full expected href per row (pagePathFrom('overview', journeyId, slug)).
